conditions.measured_as_one_stream: a database compresses page by page and sees less cross-record redundancy than a stream does, so this ratio is a ceiling on what a store achieves rather than an estimate of it
conditions.the_mixture_is_an_assumption: the proportions and the schemas were chosen, not observed; they are the first thing to change and the largest source of error here
conditions.to_use_it: re-run bench.measure.application_records against a sample of your own records, or replace the generator with one that reads them
conditions.what_this_is_about: this corpus and this codec, and nothing else

produced_by.corpus: bench.measure.application_records — JSON user profiles, orders and events in a 20/50/30 mixture, 128-bit identifiers, seeds 0-7
produced_by.mixture: 20% user profiles, 50% orders with 1-6 lines, 30% events
